Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki Farhan ki chocolate 8 mein bati, toh uska tukda 1/8; Gita ki 2 mein, toh uska 1/2; 1/8 chhota hai. Teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: board wali 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.

director.text: 1/4, 1/7, 1/10 sahi nahi hai. Har tukde ka neeche wala number dekho: woh batata hai chocolate kitne barabar tukdon mein kati. Phir patle tukde se mote tak lagao. Aaram se socho, phir batao.

Haan, sahi hai. Chocolate jitne zyada tukdon mein kate, tukda utna chhota; isliye pehle 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4. Chalo, aaj ka ek aakhri sawaal, poore paath se. Is circle ke 9 barabar tukde hain, aur 4 tukdon mein rang hai. Rangin tukde poore circle ka kaunsa fraction hain?

Bilkul sahi: neeche wala number circle ke saare 9 barabar tukde ginta hai, bina rang ke 5 nahi, aur upar wala rangin 4. Aaj dekha ki barabar tukdon ko gin kar naam dete hain, aur neeche wala number saare tukde ginta hai. Phir group ka fraction aaya, aur yeh ki ek cheez jitne zyada barabar tukdon mein kate, har tukda utna chhota. Aaj ka paath kaisa laga?
thoda mushkil tha
Achha, theek hai, maine sun liya. Aaj tumne 8 mein bati aur 2 mein bati chocolate ke tukde milaaye. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
